name: Google L4/L5 Loop
blurb: Google's software engineering on-site: two algorithm-heavy coding rounds, a system design, a low-level design, and a Googleyness & leadership behavioral.

rounds.title: Coding I
rounds.focus: Data structures and algorithms; clear reasoning out loud and tight complexity analysis.

rounds.title: Coding II
rounds.focus: Harder algorithmic problem; probe optimality and edge cases, and how they test their own code.

rounds.title: System Design
rounds.focus: Scalability and data model. When a component appears, ask why it, tradeoffs, and failure modes.

rounds.title: Low-Level Design
rounds.focus: Clean class model and API design; extensibility and separation of concerns.

rounds.title: Googleyness & Leadership
rounds.focus: Googleyness & leadership: collaboration, dealing with ambiguity, and comfort without clear authority.
